Elia Kazan's "Baby Doll" Blu-ray - Carroll Baker, Karl Malden, Eli Wallach, Lonny Chapman, Mildred Dunnock @Warner Archive
US: https://t.co/MVlpVIl1K3
CAN: https://t.co/BTHhU11H3x
UK: https://t.co/lbhqezirFQ
BONUS CAPTURES:
https://t.co/SqNQv0uXQe
OUR COMPARISON:
https://t.co/jDyo6YKe4f
Baby Doll remains one of the most audacious films of the 1950s, Elia Kazan and Tennessee Williams' black comedy of lust, spite and Southern decay that was condemned by the Legion of Decency and denounced from the pulpit, yet earned four Academy Award nominations. Seventy years on, its scandal has faded, but the sustained tease of its long, menacing afternoon, with Vacarro toying with Baby Doll in the rotting Meighan house, still plays as a cruel and very funny battle of wits among three people trying to out-scheme each other. Carroll Baker (Harlow, Something Wild, The Fourth Victim, Orgasmo, Paranoia, Station Six-Sahara, The Carpetbaggers, The Sweet Body of Deborah, Ironweed, Harem, Captain Apache, The Sky is Falling, Baba Yaga) became a star overnight as the petulant, thumb-sucking child bride who is sharper than either man assumes. Karl Malden (Fatal Vision, Patton, The Hanging Tree, Ruby Gentry, Time Limit, Gypsy, The Cat O'Nine Tails, The Sellout, Dead Ringer, Boomerang, One-Eyed Jacks, Diplomatic Courier, A Streetcar Named Desire, Panic in the Streets, Birdman of Alcatraz, The Cincinnati Kid, Don't Bother to Knock, On the Waterfront,) makes Archie Lee a sweating, self-pitying buffoon who turns dangerous when humiliated  and Eli Wallach (The Good, The Bad and The Ugly, The People Next Door, A Lovely Way to Die, The Magnificent Seven, Girlfriends, Letters From Iwo Jima, The Brain, The Hunter, Genghis Khan, Plot of Fear, The Two Jakes, Cinderella Liberty, Give Us This Day, How to Steal a Million, The Salamander, Lord Jim, The Deep, Tough Guys, The Sentinel, The Lineup, Circle of Iron, The Ghost Writer,) in his film debut, is the grinning catalyst Vacarro, the immigrant outsider who exposes the town's resentment. Mildred Dunnock steals her scenes as the dithering Aunt Rose Comfort, and Kazan (A Streetcar Named Desire, America America, Pinky, Blues in the Night, A Tree Grows in Brooklyn, Boomerang, A Face in the Crowd, Wild River, Panic in the Streets, On the Waterfront, Viva Zapata!, The Arrangement, Gentleman's Agreement,) fills the background with real Benoit locals, drawing a raw, lived-in authenticity from his Mississippi location. Boris Kaufman's (The Pawnbroker, The World of Henry Orient, Long Day's Journey Into Night, Splendor in the Grass, The Fugitive Kind, 12 Angry Men, Patterns, On the Waterfront,) sun-bleached, deep-focus black-and-white photography has never looked better on home video. Warner Archive's Blu-ray offers a very high bitrate, film-like 1080P image, a lossless 24-bit mono track and the carried-over See No Evil featurette. The 1.85:1 framing is tight in a few places, but this is a huge upgrade over the 2006 DVD and the best way to see a still-provocative classic. Very strongly recommended.

text:
MEMORANDUM OF RESPONSE

POLITICAL HISTORY DOES NOT OFFER UNIVERSALLY TRANSFERABLE TEMPLATES: REASSESSING VP CHIWENGA’S CHINHOYI INTERVENTION

By Byron Dzinoreva
PhD Candidate in Political Science, Washington State University
Email: byron.dzinoreva@wsu.edu

SUBJECT: A Strategic and Theoretical Response to Gabriel Manyati’s Open Letter to VP Chiwenga

1. Introduction

Gabriel Manyati’s open letter to VP Chiwenga presents an interesting interpretation of the political developments surrounding the 23rd ZANU PF Annual National People’s Conference in Chinhoyi. However, beneath its elaborate prescriptions on political patience, emotional discipline and strategic retreat lies a fundamental analytical weakness: the tendency to treat political history as a repository of universally transferable strategic templates.

Manyati’s central prescription appears to be that VP Chiwenga should emulate President Mnangagwa’s political survival strategy under former President Robert Mugabe, particularly following the 2004 Tsholotsho episode. The underlying argument is that President Mnangagwa survived political marginalisation through patience, discretion and the preservation of political relationships, and that VP Chiwenga should consequently adopt a similar approach. While there are valuable lessons to be drawn from President Mnangagwa’s political trajectory, historical analogy must not become a substitute for contextual political analysis.

Political actors operate within distinct institutional configurations, historical circumstances, distributions of power and strategic environments. What constituted an effective survival strategy for President Mnangagwa under Mugabe cannot automatically be prescribed as the optimal strategy for VP Chiwenga in 2026. The central argument of this memorandum is that Manyati’s assessment risks confusing tactical outcomes with strategic objectives, political restraint with political silence, and institutional victories with the broader dynamics of political influence. More importantly, it overlooks the significance of strategic signalling in situations characterised by competing political interests and uncertain future alignments.

2. The Problem of Historical Analogy: President Mnangagwa Is Not a Universal Strategic Template

Political history is instructive, but it is not deterministic. President Mnangagwa’s experience following the Tsholotsho episode must be understood within the particular political circumstances of the Mugabe administration. His subsequent political survival involved a specific configuration of political relationships, institutional structures, security-sector dynamics and historical opportunities. Manyati takes this experience and effectively converts it into a prescriptive model for VP Chiwenga. The problem with this approach is methodological. Historical analogies can illuminate political behaviour, but they cannot establish that different actors operating under different conditions must employ identical strategies. The political environment of 2004 was not the political environment of 2017, just as the political configuration of 2017 is not necessarily the configuration of 2026. Indeed, the very circumstances that enabled President Mnangagwa to exercise strategic patience under Mugabe may differ substantially from those confronting VP Chiwenga today. The same caution applies to Manyati’s invocation of Professor Jonathan Moyo. Moyo’s political trajectory cannot automatically become a predictive model for Chiwenga simply because both have, at different historical moments, occupied contested positions within ZANU PF. The danger of historical analogy is that it can illuminate the present while simultaneously obscuring the unique conditions that define it. President Mnangagwa’s survival strategy is a historical experience, not an immutable doctrine of political science.

September: The DOJ issued litigation holds on election records across 29 states and Washington, D.C.
October 26: Trump floated a $1 million reward for election fraud tips while DOJ ran its own $10,000–$30,000 incentive program.
October 29: The DOJ reinforced the 22-month federal election record preservation requirement and warned against deliberate destruction of those records.
Three days before the midterms: Trump posted Muhammad Ali’s 1971 loss to Joe Frazier. That should have been the tell. Ali’s real masterstroke came three years later against George Foreman—the rope-a-dope. Ali took the beating on the ropes on purpose. He let Foreman unload until the bigger man was spent and the crowd thought the fight was over. Then in the eighth round Ali stepped off the ropes and flattened him.
One day before the election: A Michigan judge permanently blocked deletion of original electronic poll books after certification, locking in the underlying data and metadata. “Watch Michigan.”
Around the same period: Roughly 1,000 DOJ monitors and observers blanketed 126 jurisdictions across all 50 states. Hegseth activated military intelligence, Cyber Command, and the NSA against foreign interference. DOJ’s voter-registration lawsuits tested how far federal power can reach against state control and privacy claims.
November 3: Democrats take Congress. The press loses its mind celebrating. Trump congratulates them, praises the performance, and offers to work together. He immediately distances himself from the losses—he wasn’t on the ballot, and he still holds the veto. Election Day produced scanner failures, ballot shortages, bomb threats, and disruptions. Federal cyber monitoring reported limited threats and no confirmed foreign influence operations by late that night. The preserved records now sit there as the base for any lawful audits or investigations that follow.
Clear positioning. He absorbs the hits while the other side inherits the consequences of whatever comes next.
Pull back and the pattern is obvious. Federal monitoring expanded while courts drew constitutional lines. Cyber defenses ran in parallel with evidence preservation. Congress flipped while the presidency kept its executive powers. And Trump is still congratulating the Democrats.
Ali understood the dynamic. Foreman’s aggression, overconfidence, and wasted energy became the variables that decided the fight. The punches were landing, but the conditions for the counter were already set.
Trump’s Ali posts, his post-election response, and the institutional moves around November 3 line up the same way.
The congressional loss is real. The legal processes are still running. The election records are still locked down. Trump still holds the constitutional powers of the office.
He took the immediate political damage and is now positioned for the next phase.
The Democrats have the win, the spotlight, and the appearance of victory.
Trump is about to step off the ropes and start throwing down

🇮🇷✊Iran Celebrates November 4 as Trump Suffers Midterm Defeat and Revolutionary Guards Claim 56th US Drone Kill

TEHRAN, 4 November 2026 — Iran marked its annual anti-American commemorations on Wednesday with renewed confidence as President Donald Trump suffered a crushing midterm election defeat, while Tehran claimed another American military drone had been destroyed over the Strait of Hormuz.

Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf welcomed the Democratic victories, declaring that American voters had effectively rejected Trump's military confrontation with Iran.

"Conscience or the cost of living, Americans said NO TO WAR, and we endorse this message," Ghalibaf wrote on X.

He warned Washington against ignoring the electoral verdict, suggesting further military aggression would provoke a dangerous Iranian response.

The political celebrations coincided with November 4, Iran's National Day of Fighting Global Arrogance, commemorating the 1979 seizure of the American embassy in Tehran.

Thousands marched through the capital carrying Iranian flags, chanting anti-American slogans and condemning Washington's military intervention across the Middle East.

Separately, the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps announced that its air defence units had shot down the 56th US MQ-9 Reaper drone on Wednesday. Iranian officials placed the incident over the Strait of Hormuz, near Qeshm Island, following recent US strikes. The drone claim has not been independently verified.

The Guards also said four oil tankers had struck naval mines and caught fire while attempting to cross a restricted shipping route. These assertions remained subject to independent confirmation.

In Washington, Democrats captured both chambers of Congress, weakening Trump's ability to advance his agenda during the remaining two years of his presidency.

Trump acknowledged that the Iran war contributed to Republican losses, although he defended his decision to launch the conflict.

The war, begun by American and Israeli strikes in February, has disrupted shipping, increased fuel prices and intensified criticism of Washington's foreign policy.

Iran's leadership sees the election as vindication of its resistance, but its celebrations are tempered by the possibility of renewed US attacks. Diplomacy continues while armed confrontations persist.

For Tehran, the coincidence of November 4 demonstrations, Trump's electoral setback and its latest military claims offered a powerful political narrative: a president promising American strength now facing resistance abroad and a backlash at home.

text:
November 1946. Voters split Washington, and health care got stuck in the middle.

Truman wanted national health insurance. His approval had sunk to 32%. Republicans ran on two words, "Had enough?", and took both houses of Congress.

But they didn't just say no. Senator Robert Taft offered a counter: $200 million a year in grants so states could cover people "in need or those able to pay only in part."

Truman's side refused. $200 million wouldn't do the job, they said, a state means test would mostly subsidize insurers, and passing it could delay real insurance for everyone.

Therefore neither plan ever got a floor vote.

But unions didn't wait. In 1948 and 1949 the labor board and the courts made health benefits something employers had to bargain over, so workers won Blue Cross cards at the plant instead.

So coverage went to whoever had a good job. The old, the poor and the self-employed waited 19 years for Medicare and Medicaid.

When Washington splits, health care doesn't stop. It just defaults to your boss.

I offered a 3rd-year the opportunity to accompany me to a client meeting in Washington.

He accepted immediately.

Then he mentioned that he had never traveled on the firm's private aircraft.

I explained that the firm did not own an aircraft.

He looked surprised.

I asked why he thought we did.

He said senior partners seemed to travel frequently.

I told him commercial airlines existed.

He said he assumed partners used private aviation for efficiency.

I asked who he thought paid for that efficiency.

He said the clients.

I told him to reconsider the economics.

We flew commercial.

He sat in economy.

I sat in business class.

During boarding he asked why our seats were different.

I explained that I had paid for my upgrade personally.

He asked whether that was common.

I said no.

I simply preferred not to spend 90 minutes discussing career development with him.

A man offered her modeling work. Three months later, one of her scenes brought death threats from ISIS.

It started with compliments. She was told she was beautiful and asked if she'd like to do some modeling, then nude modeling. The studio in Miami looked respectable: clean offices, family photos on the cubicles. She was 21, with no lawyer, no agent and no advisers.

Then she was filmed, and it went online. The scene that blew up had her wearing a hijab. Within days it spread worldwide.

In the video below, she tells BBC HARDtalk how it happened. Wait for what the producers did when she told them "you guys are gonna get me killed."

She says they laughed. She went ahead anyway, she says, because she was scared and intimidated, too nervous to say no. Once it was released, ISIS sent her death threats, including a map image of her apartment, and she hid in a hotel for two weeks.

She left the industry in early 2015. She says her total pay for all of it was about $12,000, with no residuals while her videos drew hundreds of millions of views. She says she still feels "one Google search away."

$12,000 total, 3 months in the industry, 2 weeks hiding in a hotel, 0 residuals.

Was she a willing adult who made a choice, or a 21-year-old pressured by people who knew exactly what they were doing?

text:
BurkeyLoan Proposes Transferring 70% of the GSE Single-Family Mortgage Business to America's Next Generation Through Expanded Trump Accounts A proposed national housing-affordability initiative would give Americans born between 1990 and 2040 a direct ownership stake in the nation's mortgage-finance system—with the ability to use that equity to help purchase a home.  
A Proposal by BurkeyLoan™, a Burkey Capital Entity MIAMI, FL — BurkeyLoan™, a Burkey Capital entity focused on innovative housing-finance and homeownership solutions, is proposing a landmark restructuring of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac that would transfer 70% ownership of their combined single-family mortgage businesses to current and future generations of American citizens through an expanded Trump Accounts program. The proposal seeks to turn one of the nation's largest mortgage-finance enterprises into a source of personal wealth, homeownership assistance and long-term economic opportunity for the generation that will shape America's housing market for decades to come. America's Homeownership Crisis Is Becoming a Generational Crisis Homeownership has historically been one of America's most important pathways to financial security, household wealth and family stability. Increasingly, that opportunity is slipping beyond the reach of younger Americans. The median age of first-time homebuyers reached 40 in 2025, reflecting the growing difficulty of accumulating sufficient savings, qualifying for mortgage financing and purchasing a first home. Rising housing costs, down-payment requirements, consumer debt and other financial pressures are delaying independent household formation and contributing to broader concerns about family formation and economic mobility. These trends raise a fundamental national question: How can America restore the opportunity for younger generations to own a home, build wealth and participate in the prosperity of the country they will inherit? BurkeyLoan believes part of the solution could come from a new approach to ownership of the nation's government-sponsored mortgage enterprises. Transforming the GSEs Into a Generational Ownership Opportunity Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac, collectively known as the Government-Sponsored Enterprises (GSEs), are central to the American residential mortgage market. Together, they support trillions of dollars of residential mortgage financing and generate substantial annual earnings through their mortgage investment and guarantee activities. Although privately chartered and shareholder-owned, both enterprises have operated under federal conservatorship since 2008. The U.S. Treasury holds substantial senior preferred interests and warrants to acquire 79.9% of each enterprise's common stock. BurkeyLoan proposes using a negotiated federal restructuring of these interests to establish a new ownership arrangement that directly benefits American citizens and advances the national objective of affordable homeownership. Under the proposal, the GSEs' single-family mortgage operations would be separated into a distinct ownership structure, while their multifamily operations would remain under federal ownership or control pursuant to the final restructuring agreements. A Proposed 70% Ownership Stake for America's Next Generation The centerpiece of the proposal is the allocation of 70% of the restructured GSE Single-Family Business to U.S. citizens born between January 1, 2000, and December 31, 2040. The proposed distribution would use an expanded Trump Accounts framework to give eligible citizens individually owned, transferable economic interests in the enterprise. Approximately 156 million births are estimated to occur in the United States over this 41-year period, including more than 102 million already recorded through 2025. Actual eligibility would be determined by citizenship and the rules of the new program. The objective is straightforward: provide young Americans with an ownership asset that can grow in value, support homeownership and create a lasting connection between the nation's mortgage-finance system and the citizens it serves. This would require expanding the existing Trump Accounts program to accommodate eligible adult citizens, future generations and the proposed GSE equity interests. Make Ownership Immediately Useful for Buying a Home Unlike conventional long-term investment programs, the proposed GSE ownership initiative would include a special homeownership provision. Eligible account holders could elect to use the value of their allocated GSE shares toward the purchase of a qualifying primary residence, subject to the program's final rules and applicable law. Alternatively, an account holder could transfer or gift eligible shares to another qualifying homebuyer, allowing the benefit to support homeownership within families or across generations. This approach would create two complementary benefits: 1.Immediate housing affordability: Eligible shares could provide a source of purchase equity, potentially reducing the cash savings or mortgage principal needed to acquire a home. 2.Long-term wealth creation: Account holders who do not use their shares for housing could retain them as an investment in the single-family mortgage enterprise. The intention is to make ownership meaningful—not simply to distribute an investment that younger Americans cannot use when homeownership opportunities arise. The program would be designed to complement existing mortgage financing, including qualifying conventional mortgages and innovative affordability programs. Encourage Long-Term Ownership While Preserving Housing Flexibility To support stable, long-term participation in the restructured enterprise, BurkeyLoan proposes restrictions on the general sale of allocated shares. Outside qualifying homeownership transactions, beneficiaries would be required to satisfy both conditions before selling: •Hold their shares for at least ten years. •Reach at least 30 years of age. A qualifying primary-residence purchase would provide an exception to these restrictions. Eligible transfers to assist another homebuyer would also be permitted under defined program safeguards. These provisions are intended to discourage short-term speculation while preserving the shares' primary purpose: helping Americans establish financial independence and achieve homeownership. Proposed Ownership Structure BurkeyLoan proposes the following allocation of common equity in the restructured GSE Single-Family Business: Proposed beneficiariesOwnership allocation Eligible U.S. citizens born 2000–2040, through expanded Trump Accounts70% Existing GSE junior preferred shareholders20% GSE employees4% U.S. government, reserved for a potential public offering6% Total100% The allocations represent a proposed post-restructuring ownership structure, subject to negotiation, valuation, regulatory approval and resolution of existing Treasury and shareholder rights. Protecting Existing Junior Preferred Shareholders The proposal recognizes the longstanding investment interests of existing GSE junior preferred shareholders. Under the proposed restructuring, these shareholders would be offered a choice between: •Equity conversion: Exchange their junior preferred holdings for an allocated collective 20% ownership interest in the restructured single-family enterprise, under a negotiated conversion arrangement. •Scheduled liquidation: Elect an orderly settlement or redemption of their preferred holdings over a five-year period, pursuant to an approved financing and payment structure. The objective is to offer existing investors a defined path toward resolution while enabling the GSEs to transition to a new ownership structure. Recognizing GSE Employees Employees would collectively receive 4% of the restructured enterprise. The proposed employee equity program would distribute awards annually over ten years. Each annual award would carry a three-year vesting cliff, subject to continued service and the program's final terms. This would recognize the workforce's contribution to the enterprises' financial performance while aligning employees with the long-term interests of future homeowners and citizen shareholders. Preserving Federal Interests and the Multifamily Mortgage Business Under the proposal, the federal government would retain 6% of the restructured single-family enterprise, with that interest reserved for a potential future public offering. The proposed transaction would also leave the GSE Multifamily Business—which supports financing for apartments and other multifamily rental housing—under federal ownership or control through a separately determined structure. This distinction is significant. The proposal is specifically intended to apply the single-family mortgage business to the national objective of expanding individual homeownership while preserving the government's ability to support rental housing through multifamily finance. An independent valuation negotiated treatment of Treasury's existing investments, an appropriate capital structure and legally required federal approvals would be necessary to establish the final financial terms. A Housing-Affordability Initiative, Not Simply a Privatization BurkeyLoan's proposal differs fundamentally in purpose from a conventional GSE privatization or public stock offering. A traditional restructuring would principally determine the value of the enterprises and the distribution of proceeds among investors and the government. BurkeyLoan proposes using the restructuring to create a direct and enduring homeownership benefit for American citizens. Instead of concentrating the economic opportunity associated with the single-family mortgage business among a relatively limited group of investors, the proposed structure would distribute a substantial ownership interest across an entire generation. The resulting equity could become an additional financial resource for Americans who face increasing difficulty purchasing their first homes. At the same time, continued enterprise profitability and responsible mortgage financing could provide a foundation for long-term shareholder value. The final proposal would need to address mortgage-market stability, taxpayer interests, adequate enterprise capitalization, the protection of mortgage-backed securities investors and the preservation of affordable mortgage financing. A New Stake in the American Dream The generation born between 2000 and 2040 will determine much of America's future household formation, homeownership demand, workforce development and economic prosperity. BurkeyLoan believes public policy should recognize the extraordinary importance of enabling this generation to establish financial independence. Transferring a meaningful ownership interest in the nation's single-family mortgage-finance system could connect two national objectives that are too often considered separately: creating wealth and making homeownership affordable. The proposal is intended to begin a national discussion with policymakers, federal housing authorities, Treasury officials, investors, industry participants and other interested stakeholders. It is an independent proposal by BurkeyLoan and Burkey Capital. It has not been approved or adopted by the U.S. government, Treasury, FHFA, Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac or the Trump Accounts program. Implementation would require substantial legal, financial and regulatory action. America helped build the mortgage-finance system. BurkeyLoan proposes giving the next generation a direct stake in its future—and an opportunity to turn that stake into a home of their own. ____ About BurkeyLoan™ BurkeyLoan™, a Burkey Capital entity, is developing innovative residential mortgage-finance solutions intended to expand affordable homeownership. Its proposed programs emphasize payment-based affordability, alternative collateral enhancement, reduced traditional down-payment requirements and new methods of connecting mortgage borrowers with investment capital. Learn more: https://t.co/IMCNOiA2J9 BurkeyLoan™ is a proposed housing-finance initiative. The GSE restructuring described above is a policy proposal and does not constitute an announced transaction, government program, securities offering or commitment by any referenced institution.

text:
STATEMENT FROM SENATOR MICHAEL LEE

Last night I called Jessica Bichler to congratulate her on her victory. The voters of New Hanover County have made their choice, and I respect it. I wish her well as she takes on the responsibility of representing this community in the Senate.

Twenty years ago, I first asked my neighbors for their vote when I ran for the Board of Education. Every campaign since has been built on the same idea: that the people of New Hanover County deserve leaders who show up, do the work, and get results. Serving this community has been one of the great honors of my life.

Together we strengthened protections for our drinking water, invested in the infrastructure a growing region needs, expanded opportunities for students and families, and made sure Southeastern North Carolina had a strong voice when the state's budget was written.

I am deeply grateful to everyone who supported this campaign and the ones before it: those who gave, volunteered, knocked doors, made calls, and offered encouragement and prayers along the way. I am also grateful to the staff who served this district with skill and dedication, and to my colleagues in the Senate.

Most of all, I want to thank my wife, Heidi, and our children. For twenty years, public service has asked a great deal of our family, and they gave it with grace.

My term continues through the end of the year, and I will keep working for the people of this district until the last day. Wilmington has been my home for a long time, and it will remain so. I look forward to continuing to serve this community in new ways.

Thank you, New Hanover County.

text:
Twenty-Third Sunday After Pentecost by Fr. Francis Xavier Weninger, 1877 
.
"And when the multitude was put forth, he went in and took her by the hand, and the maid arose." 
.
"I will lead thee into solitude, and there speak to thy heart." These are the words of the Holy Ghost, in the Canticle of Canticles, and indicate the disposition which a soul striving after perfection must have in order to receive the inspirations of that Spirit of Love, take them to heart, and follow the call of divine grace. 
.
In seeking perfection several things are essential, viz., love of solitude, a refraining from useless conversation, and from all that tends to distract the soul from that desired end. A similar course must be pursued when a sinner is to be aroused from that spiritual death which sin has brought upon his soul, and to this the Gospel of today has reference. 
.
Jesus was called to the house of a ruler, where He found a multitude gathered, for death had taken away his daughter in her youth. 
.
But Jesus did not perform the miracle until the noisy multitude was put forth, for the expression of Holy Scripture is literally "put forth,"--from which we are led to infer that the crowd did not go willingly, but resisted those who obeyed the command of our Saviour and required them to leave. Dearly beloved in Christ, let us apply this circumstance to the conversion of a sinner from his dangerous state. 
.
Before that sinner can be restored from spiritual death to eternal life, his heart must be free from all strife and tumult. And what is this commotion which rages in his heart? We will consider it briefly today. 
.
Mary, princess of peace, we pray thee, calm the storm that sweeps over the sinner's poor soul, that, when Jesus bids him "arise," he may listen to His voice! I speak in the most holy name of Jesus, for the greater honor and glory of God ! 
.
But if the sinner does not hear the sweet voice of his Saviour, or if it sound to his unwilling ear as the echo of some voice far away, or, if hearing it, he cares not to turn and obey the call, it is because his heart is always absorbed in the dissipations of this world. 
.
First, there is the tumult of the passions in the heart of the sinner, who is borne hither and thither, swayed now by one evil impulse and then by another of the various sins which have become habitual to him. This tumult is like the raging of the sea, when the roaring of the angry waves prevents one from hearing the voice of another who calls from afar. Cast but one glance at the tempest-tossed life of the sinner, or even look into your own heart, and you may see there the reality of what I have described. of pride holds sway. Day and night he is engrossed by thoughts and schemes to mount higher and higher, until he reaches the most exalted pinnacle--of earthly fame. And, oh ! how wildly rages the tumult in his heart, when his well-devised schemes have failed to gain his ends ; and, instead of honor and fame, his only reward is the scorn and contempt of men. With his heart thus filled with conflicting emotions, there is no room for any thought of God to enter there. 
.
The ruling passion of another is avarice. Poor, tempest-tossed sinner! The noisy multitude clamoring in his heart will not let him hear the voice of Jesus, which bids him arise. Those endless schemes to increase his store, to amass riches until the worshipers of mammon will bow down before him, cause the tumult, which must cease before he can hearken to the call of grace. He knows no rest, fearing to be deprived of his prized wealth, his cherished treasure, but caring not to lay it away where neither moth nor rust can destroy nor thieves break in and bear it away. Should his fears be realized, the tumult rages more fiercely than ever; and, until the noisy multitude be put forth, there can be no thought of an earnest conversion to God. 
.
But what words can be found to adequately express the state of that sinner who is held fast in the thralldom of lust! By day and by night the tumult of his passions rages so fiercely that he is entirely deaf to the voice of that Saviour who calls on him to repent, and whose loving, compassionate heart will not refuse pardon even to him ! 
.
Another allows anger and impatience to rage in his breast, and the tumultuous thoughts which arise therefrom, the feelings of revenge and hostility which abound, drown the voice of Jesus. Yes, and so loud is the tumult, so deafening its roar, that it is often heard afar off in quarrels and contentions, in blasphemy. Even murder results from anger. Until this noisy multitude is put forth, the sinner will be deaf to the voice of his God. 
.
What confusion and tumult prevails in the heart of the drunkard ! The despicable vice of intemperance leads its victims to forget every thing their families, their honor, their religion, for drink winds round them a chain which they care not to break, and begets a tumult within and without. Look at the drunkard, as he emerges from some midnight revel, caring naught for the warning of his friends, the admonitions of his pastor, or the pleading of his Saviour for admission into his degraded heart. Not until the noisy multitude is put forth, can Jesus bid him arise from spiritual death. 
.
With others the passion of envy is the principal failing, and it is a constant source of agitation to those who indulge in it. Torn by conflicting emotions at the sight of the happiness which others enjoy, the victim of envy feels no rest nor peace in his miserable heart. In his futile repinings, he opens that heart to a noisy multitude of rebellious murmurings; and how can he listen to the whisperings of the Holy Ghost, the Spirit of Love, until their clamor is stilled? 
.
Neither does the vice of sloth exempt the heart of the sinner from the presence of that multitude, the clamor of which entirely drowns the Saviour's voice. 
.
On the contrary, the Christian, whose ruling passion it is, is particularly prone to dissipations and distractions; and the deadly lethargy which possesses him renders him powerless to still the tumult and put the multitude forth. 
.
To all who listen today to my voice I would say: Empty your hearts, and cultivate that spirit of recollection which will make you realize what alone is necessary to work out your salvation. Few, in the light of that eternity which draws nearer each moment, the vanity and nothingness of all that for which you so eagerly strive. Nothing so earnestly conduces to a true conversion as frequent meditation on death. 
.
"And when the multitude was put forth, Jesus went in and took her by the hand." A vivid realization of the certainty of death and its rapid approach takes the sinner, as it were, by the hand to raise him from his lethargy. 
.
Besides this interior tumult engendered by the various passions, there are also many exterior circumstances which keep him in a state of constant disgust. Nay, even the Christian, who is not guilty of very grievous offenses, experiences this also. 
.
First, there are the thousand distractions of daily life which crowd upon the man who, wholly taken up with the idea of providing for his support as well as he can, and, perhaps, of laying up the wealth of this world, can not spare time to think of the next. He is too busy to burst the bonds of sin and be converted to God. 
.
The busy signs of life in a large city, the constant turmoil, the ceaseless hurrying to and fro of crowds in eager pursuit of some favorite aim, all show how little consideration is given to the solemn truth that we are destined to die. 
.
Even those who are placed above the necessity of working for their maintenance, nevertheless find ample excuse for directing their thoughts from heaven and God. Some are so engrossed with politics, with schemes and plans for the advancement of themselves, of their friends, or of their party, that they forget to pray, or to fulfill their duties as Catholics. If the whispers of conscience can not be entirely stilled, their cry is: "Tomorrow! tomorrow!" and so day after day passes by, until, without warning, the end craweth nigh, and then cometh the night "wherein no man can work." The votary of pleasure plunges recklessly into every dissipation, drinking deeply of the poisoned cup, and seeking thus vainly to gratify passion, which, alas, is insatiable! Mark it well, most beloved in Christ, that Jesus did not restore the dead girl to life until the noisy multitude was put forth. Then drive from your hearts and banish forever the tumultuous multitude of thoughts and temptations which these seven deadly sins engender therein. 
.
Meditate upon death, remember your last end, and you will repent of your sins; your Saviour, who died for you upon the cross, will bid your souls arise from the sleep of spiritual death, and may God grant that you will hearken to His voice ! Amen !
.
"And they laughed Him to scorn."--Matt. 9, 24. 
.
The noisy multitude mocked and laughed at Jesus. The soldiers of the governor assembled together, and after having removed His garments, they, in derision, put a scarlet cloak about Him, and a crown of thorns upon His head, and a reed for a scepter in His hand, while they heaped every insult upon Him. But not only the rabble treated Him thus; for Herod and his wicked courtiers loaded this meek and suffer ing Saviour of the world with every species of ignominy which malice could suggest ! 
.
Even when He hung in agony upon the cross, to consummate the great work of redemption, the Pharisees stood beneath and laughed Him to scorn! But, lo! the sun was darkened, the earth trembled to her very depths, the dead arose and walked abroad , the vail in the temple was rent asunder; for nature, appalled at the mighty wrong that had been wrought by man, gave evidence of her grief and woe. Then, those who had been loudest in their wicked treatment of our Saviour were terrified, and went away filled with confusion! 
.
As Christ was treated, my brethren, so will be treated all those who follow His divine example by walking in the sorrowful way of the cross. As He was persecuted, so will His devoted children be persecuted; as He was reviled, so will they be covered with scorn; as He was nailed to the cross, so must they expect to be nailed to the cross of mortification and ignominy. Christ has foretold this, and as He Himself says: "The disciple is not greater than his Master." 
.
Thus it was in ages past, and thus it will continue. The Pagan world mocked and derided the Church of God, and those who are not of her fold do it today. The heretic, the apostate, and the Christian who is so in name alone, fling insults and scorn at the Church and her faithful children, and their wickedness shall not cease until time shall be no more ! But, my dear brethren, you who are striving to fulfill the holy will of your divine Master, do not permit this mockery to disturb yon, but rather let it be a subject of joy ! 
.
Mary, who beneath the cross, didst bear with unshaken courage the cruel mockeries offered to thy divine Son, assist us to accept with patience, and even joy, for Christ s sake, the affronts which we, as Catholics, may have to bear! I speak in the most holy name of Jesus, for the greater honor and glory of God ! 
.
Among the innumerable weapons by which hell, with its earthly accomplices, seeks to attack and assault the Church, the kingdom of God, collectively and individually, there is none that works such irremediable mischief as ridicule. Regarded in itself, it seems to be harmless, and incapable of gaining even a passing notice from those against whom it is aimed; but, alas ! it is not so, for a dread of being laughed at has not only, in many instances, kept Protestants and infidels from entering that Church which, in their hearts, they believe to be the only one wherein salvation is to be found, but it has been effective in preventing the return to God of those who have strayed from the path of virtue ! Alas! that terrible fear that worldlings will laugh at their piety, has proved the eternal ruin of many a soul! What folly to regard the mockery of poor worms of the earth like themselves! Let us briefly consider who are they who ridicule us if we openly profess our faith, and live, according to its divine teachings, pious, pure, and holy lives. 
.
Even though they may be sceptered monarchs, adorned with glittering diadems, and seated upon lofty thrones, they are poor frail mortals, mortals doomed to die,--whose appearance in a few short days after death will be most revolting, subjects, not indeed for ridicule, but for the deepest disgust! They are men with perhaps the guilt of mortal sin upon their souls, in whom are verified the description of Christ : Being born of the devil, and resembling him! 
.
Oh, could we but see the deformity of a soul in this diabolical state, we would almost die of horror ! Who are they who ridicule the faithful children of God ? They are mortals who must one day be called before the judgment-seat of Christ, and, if they appear before that terrible tribunal, weighed down with the guilt of that mockery upon their souls, they will surely be among those who, on the last day, will cry out : "Woe to us, fools, who laughed and derided them, and now they are among the children of light ; but the way of truth was not with us!" Who are those scoffers? Men who, when on the last great day, the most hidden crimes will be revealed, will shriek aloud, begging the mountains to fall on them, and the hills to cover them up, but instead they will be covered with ignominy and scorn. Then will they be forced to hear, extended by Christ to the just, the gracious invitation: "Come, ye blessed of My Father, possess the kingdom prepared for you from the beginning of the world;" while upon them will be pronounced the terrible sentence: "Depart from Me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire," and they will descend body and soul into hell! 
.
Thus will the Lord fulfill His promise: "Whosoever will confess Me before man, I will also confess him before My Father who is in heaven," before all the angels and saints, when I shall come in all My power and majesty, to render to every man accord ing to his works! 
.
Let these considerations induce you, my brethren, to disregard the ridicule aimed at you by the enemies of our holy faith, who mock at and revile all those who strive to show forth by their lives that theirs is not a dead, but a living faith. They despise those who live not to amass the treasures of this world, but to lay up everlasting riches in a happy eternity, who care not to seek the transitory honors and empty favor of this world, when a few brief years of self-denial will put them into possession of eternal joys! 
.
They despise you because you believe, and yet how many unanswerable arguments prove the truth of faith as Christ announced it to the world ! When Jesus raised the dead daughter of the ruler to life, admiration and wonder took the place of derision ! 
.
This miracle and numberless others, as well as the resurrection of Christ Himself, ratify the truths of faith, which are supported, moreover, by the testimony of the Prophets, illustrated by the holiness of the Gospel's teachings, by all the glorious labors of Holy Church for the salvation of the human race, by the virtuous lives not only of many who are still living upon earth, but also of those who, by the sanctity of their lives, have merited to be pronounced saints by this Holy Catholic Church, and are in heaven! 
.
Is there anything more glorious than this Holy Church which we call our mother, to which Christ has assigned such pre-eminence by her four marks. She is One, Holy, Catholic and Apostolic; and, for over eighteen hundred years, she has illumined and enlightened the world. Is there not every reason to be proud of being children of this glorious mother? 
.
Ah, my dear friends, the enemies of the Church have no reason to revile those who live as her true children. They ridicule the practice of prayer, knowing nothing of the sweetness contained therein, and utterly ignorant that the fervent Catholic enjoys a happiness to them incomprehensible of union with God while yet on earth, and an abundance of spiritual favors therefrom. They laugh at you because you assist at divine service, in their ignorance of the sublimity of that sacrifice which the Church offers up, and the graces contained in the reception of the most adorable Sacrament of the altar. 
.
They laugh at you, faithful Catholics, because you do not rush eagerly in pursuit of worldly riches, honors and pleasures, but prefer those which are eternal. They despise you because, like Solomon, you feel impelled to exclaim: "Vanity of vanities, all is vanity," save to love and serve God. Why? St. Augustine tells us when he says that God has created our hearts for Himself, and that they shall find no rest until they rest in Him. Therefore, let us never lose courage when we are laughed at for doing our duty, nor be dejected when we are striving to follow the example of the crucified One, who was mocked and derided and cruelly reviled. Then, through Him, we will one day be eternally glorified in that heavenly home where, with the whole celestial host, we will entone the praises of our Saviour Jesus Christ! Amen!

The Chief Justice: “thank you, counsel. ms. ferguson?”

Ms. Ferguson: “mr. chief justice, and may it please the court, respondent seeks prospective application of an old rule that was available when he filed his first habeas application 15 years ago. that claim does not satisfy aedpa's bar on second or successive habeas applications. atkins is not a new rule with respect to respondent because it was decided five years before his conviction. he cannot seek retroactive application of a constitutional rule that existed and applied before he even committed his crimes. and the atkins rule was previously available during his first habeas application. atkins was the law of the land, and he used it to advance a different claim in that same application. respondent's contrary reading, which would allow successive habeas applications any time doctors change their understanding of intellectual disability, would seriously undermine congress's choice in edpa to prioritize finality over successive habeas applications spanning decades. this court should reverse. i welcome the court's questions. do you agree with the state that we should decide this on the previously unavailable prong? i think this court could resolve it on either prong. i think it would be most helpful to address both and address the statute holistically. so just to discuss the new rule issue to begin, i think justice jackson's questions about whether new rule encompasses a concept of the sorts of rules that the court has at one time deemed a new rule that was important enough to make retroactive, i think that is inconsistent with the way this court has, in dozens of cases, described what it means for a rule to be new. it's consistently described the concept of a new rule as with respect to the particular defendant who is invoking the rule, and that's in cases both pre- and post-edpa. you have cases pre-edpa like safl, you have cases post-edpa like wharton v. bockting. but those could be -- and i guess i'm just a little concerned that if we -- that we have two timing issues in this statute. we have previously unavailable, which is particular to the petitioner, but it's not clear to me that congress intended for the phrase "new rule" in the way that it exists in the other part of the statute to also do that work, because you could end up with a situation in which you have such overlap that one part of the statute is superfluous, if we read it in the way that you're talking about. can you speak to that? yeah, so i think i would point to a few things. one is, for example, this court in magwood described section b -- uh, subsection b2(a) as requiring intervening case law, and i think that puts a really fine point on it. this is not just a rule that was new at the time it was decided. this is a rule that is -- has intervened in the time between the individual's conviction and this -- this application. and so, that, i think, is -- is some evidence of what the -- do we have evidence that that's what congress intended, that that's what they were doing in this statute? i think by incorporating language that very, very closely tracks teague and that -- and given that teague was describing when these rules can apply on collateral review, it would be exceedingly unusual for the court to use the same framework that teague adopted but divorce it from the rule that teague was actually applying, which requires that it be, uh, new with respect to the particular defendant. that makes a fair bit of sense to me, ms. ferguson, but it still leaves sort of my alternative theory, which is, yes, we are talking about with relation to the particular defendant, but we don't have to think of atkins -- and, indeed, it would be wrong to think of atkins as a single rule that we decided exactly when we decided the atkins case, given that atkins was very cognizant that the substantive standard for the rule was going to be supplied principally by diagnostic criteria. so, if the diagnostic criteria fundamentally changes, as it did between dsm-iv and dsm-v, you basically get an atkins-ii rule, um, and -- and -- and then the question, with respect to that defendant, would be whether, um, uh, that is new. well, i think a -- a few responses to that, justice kagan. one is that i think it's -- it's difficult to imagine congress enacting a law that would allow, um, the american psychiatric association without independent action of this court to create a new rule of constitutional law. well, i suspect congress didn't think about this one way or the other. it was not thinking about atkins claims when it wrote this statute, and i completely agree with you that, uh, uh -- i mean, i think that part of what you're saying is the -- the atkins standard is a very unusual one, so congress wouldn't have been thinking about it. but i think that that doesn't answer the point, because congress didn't reject it either. i mean, we just have this very unusual kind of rule, which, um -- which the -- which -- whose legal standard is supplied, um, uh, at least partly, maybe principally, by something else. and so, when that something else changes, the rule changes. sure. i -- i think, looking at atkins, the substantive rule that atkins announced was that individuals who were intellectually disabled at the time they committed their crime, uh, cannot be sentenced to ex -- to -- to death for that, because they lack the culpability necessary to warrant execution. that rule isn't changed by the adoption of a new dsm. that is the underlying rule of atkins. that's what hall described the rule of atkins as. and so, the dsm updating who falls within the definition of intellectually disabled or who might be diagnosed as intellectually disabled isn't creating a new rule of constitutional law. the rule of constitutional law is the same. well, what -- what is it doing? i mean, i think peterson said it was supplying a fact, but i -- i guess i don't really see it that way. it's supply -- it's applying, sort of, the content to the new legal rule. it's like the legal rule is one with a -- a -- a big gap in it and understanding that something else is going to supply the content. so, uh, the dsm comes and plugs it in, and it becomes part of the legal standard, not anything to do with, uh, facts. sure. i -- i think atkins, to the extent it incorporated, uh, the dsm and updated psychological understandings of intellectual disability, it also incorporated state processes for determining intellectual disability. it expressly said that states would be responsible for developing the method of determining intellectual disability, and i don't think that it would make a lot of sense for there to be an available successive application any time the relevant state had a -- a new case, a new state supreme court case, for example, or even a state lower court case that changed the framework that the state was using. i think that would run contrary to the structure of the law, which is the structure of b2a, uh, which says that it has to be a new rule of constitutional law made retroactive to cases on collateral review by this court. and i think that when the update that renders the rule available on respondents' view is the dsm or, for that matter, some state court decision that's changing the way that a court is to assess an iq score or a -- a type of adaptive functioning, then that can't possibly trigger b2a because it's not a new rule of constitutional law made retroactive by this court. what if the court said so and made it prospective? what if the court said, "we are announcing this rule, and in the future, if the category changes per state law, we intend for that to be applied retroactively"? would they have to just do it every time there's -- is -- is your position that it only satisfies the retroactive part of the statute if the supreme court, um, rubber-stamps each change in the dsm? i think if -- if the court -- if this court says, "now the dsm is the governing standard," then i think that's a -- a procedural change, and so i -- i don't know that that -- i suppose if this court said it is retroactive anyway, then that would satisfy it. i don't think it would ordinarily be considered retroactive under the way -- you know, after edwards and the way this court conceptualizes what it means for a rule to be substantive versus procedural and therefore retroactive. um, but if this court expressly said, "we think that the substance of an atkins claim depends on the dsm-5 and that is retroactive," then that could be the basis for a second or successive -- mr. -- ms. ferguson, um, we had some questions earlier about the -- what happens when a -- a new rule is announced made retroactive during the pendency of a first habeas petition, and i just wanted to give you -- if you have any additional thoughts to what ms. -- mr. peterson had offered, the chance to do so. yeah, so i -- i agree with, uh -- with mr. peterson that, um, there's no need to address the particular circumstances in this case. it's not presented by this case, but if this court wanted to wade into exactly when during the first habeas, um, the rule would have to be announced, i do think that a final judgment rule makes sense. i think it accords with this court's approach in rivers, um, and it accords with the availability of, uh, you know, habeas actions are generally, for most purposes in the civil rules, considered civil actions. you can amend your application, uh, once as of right. you can also amend it again if justice requires, um, and so in that circumstance, if this court were to announce something that really is a new rule retroactive on collateral review, then that would provide -- mr. chief justice, may i -- sure. -- that would provide an opportunity to address it on first habeas.”

The Chief Justice: “justice thomas, any -- justice alito?”

Justice Thomas: “to, uh, follow up on -- excuse me -- justice kagan's line of questioning about the nature of the atkins rule, um, would you say that the rule is that, uh, a person, uh, may not be executed if the person has an intellectual disability that is regarded as such by medical professionals? that's one alternative. or would you say it is that a person may not be executed if the person has an intellectual disability that can't be justified by the recognized purposes of punishment, particularly retribution and deterrence, in which case the dsm would be evidence, uh, but not part of the standard itself? i think your latter formulation, um, captures what the -- the atkins eighth amendment rule was. thank you.”

The Chief Justice: “justice sotomayor?”

Justice Sotomayor: “i -- i'm not altogether sure. i understood your answer to justice gorsuch. okay. you are taking the position that, um, do you want to limit this -- you -- you said to justice thomas earlier that you wanted to go under both prongs, but your colleague wanted to limit this to that it can't be a new rule if it was announced before the filing of the first petition. uh, justice sotomayor, i -- my -- our position, certainly, and i understand, uh, general peterson's position to be that it cannot be a new rule if it was announced after, uh -- it -- it cannot be a new rule with respect to a particular applicant if it was announced after that applicant -- uh, before that applicant's conviction. i thought he said it differently. i took down what he said. can't be a new rule if it was announced before filing of the first petition. he didn't say before the final conviction, because there is a final conviction the moment you file a habeas. you're trying to undo that final conviction. so i -- i suppose i'm best speaking just for -- for our own position. i think that, um, it is a new rule -- the -- the timing of a new rule is defined with respect to when the particular defendant's conviction becomes final. the timing for previous availability is tied to the first habeas application. now you're -- now you're doing two different. that makes no sense to me. you know, i understand the general's position, but yours makes no sense. why would you have two different timeframes? i think the -- the new rule announced before this, but not before the -- but not previously available until the first habeas? i think that accounts for why the statute has two different terms that both have reference to timing. so "new" is incorporating the concept from teague, which is tied to the time of conviction, and then "previously unavailable" should be tied to the first habeas application or the immediately preceding habeas application, because we're dealing with second or successive habeas applications specifically. so the question in a second or successive is whether it could have been raised in the first or the immediately preceding. um, and so that's -- that's how we, um, would justify the -- the two different timing questions, one for new rule and the other for previous unavailability. well, you're not unhappy with the general's suggest -- suggestion, really. i -- i didn't understand us to be advancing different positions, but to the extent that they are -- we can both listen to the transcript. justice kagan? justice gorsuch? justice barrett? justice jackson? thank you, counsel. thank you.”

text:
Yakuza 0: Cabaret Club Czar

Original Yakuza 0. Business-story spoilers below.

All right, this is the Cabaret Club Czar guide for Yakuza 0. I want to go through the actual process here, because there is a difference between getting through a few shifts and understanding what you need to do to finish the whole thing.

The goal is to build Club Sunshine up, beat the Five Stars, and finish the business storyline. But don't stop at the last rival if you're also working toward the substories. The hostess training is its own part of that process.

Cabaret Club Czar opens during Majima's Chapter 7 story. Finish Sunshine's introductory shift first. Unlock reference: https://t.co/Jz2lyVLY9D

Getting a shift under control

Talk to Youda, prepare your cast, and fill all eight slots. Check condition before every shift. Rest unhappy hostesses rather than sending the same exhausted lineup back out.

Talk, Party, Love and Skill are service abilities. Sexy, Beauty, Cute and Funny are appearance ratings. HP is stamina. Keep coverage across the service abilities instead of stacking one strength.

When seating a customer, preview his face with each hostess highlighted. Pink is the match you want. The selection pauses the action, so use that breathing room. Wealthier customers are harder to satisfy but pay more. You can replace a hostess at an occupied table to free her for a better match elsewhere.

Sunshine Fever affects two tables at level one, four at level two and six at level three. It boosts spending and restores hostess HP. Don't hold a charged meter forever waiting for a perfect room.

Think of it this way: if you keep losing control, simplify your next shift. Watch customer matches first, then requests, then Fever. Speed comes after you understand what the screen is telling you.

Club mechanics reference: https://t.co/EvVjvQKwbU

The six hand signals

Keep this beside you until you remember them:

- L-shaped finger and thumb: Guest Glass.
- Curved C-shaped hand: Ladies' Glass.
- Wringing motion: Towel.
- Two open hands, like presenting a book: Menu.
- Hands forming a round container: Swap Ashtray.
- Downward hand with thumb and little finger extended: Refill Ice.

Answering correctly improves the table and replenishes HP. Don't ignore the request because the hostess was doing well a moment ago.

At checkout, an accepted extension keeps the customer spending at the boosted rate. Gifts help fan growth. When the alternate checkout choices appear, rewarding the hostess restores more HP than praising her, but costs money. Pick based on what you need: fans for progression or a working hostess for the rest of this shift.

Trouble is different from a normal request. Protecting a hostess can restore her HP but may send an angry guest away. An apology gift costs money to try to improve the guest's mood. Neither replaces getting the original pairing right.

Hand-signal and table-response reference: https://t.co/o2rYqdrb3V

Build the roster before trying to force the rivals

Yuki starts with you. The other Platinums come from rival wins: Ai from Mars, Saki from Jupiter, Hibiki from Mercury, Chika from Venus and Mana from Moon.

Useful recruits outside that progression:

- Etsuko: finish The Obatarian Strikes. Strong Talk support.
- Miss Isobe: finish Disco Dancing Goddess. Strong Party support.
- Dolly: complete the Doll Girl friendship.
- Unknown: complete Simon the Mystery Man's friendship.
- Erranda: finish Errands on the Run.

Check beside Sunshine for eligible recruits after completing their requirements. Buy Casting Call rewards at the temple to expand the roster further.

Street recruits require presents from Le Marche:

- Akemi, east of the southwest save point: ladies' wallet or watch.
- Hiroko, East Shofukucho taxi: coat or scarf.
- Harumi, near Tsuruhashi Fugetsu: handbag.
- Kirara, east of the temple: boots or sandals.
- Ume, western Sotenbori Street: leopard-print item.
- Mitsuko, southern Bunzaemon Outdoor Mall: ring, bracelet or necklace.
- Fusae, below the north end of Iwao Bridge: perfume.

Harumi, Kirara and Ume may already have joined through your earlier Odyssey preparation. Don't mistake that for a missing recruit.

Recruitment reference: https://t.co/GCDoZeeHhR

Train and dress your Platinums

Makeovers change appearance ratings, not just the way a hostess looks on screen. Adjust the clothes and accessories while watching the rating symbols. A strong set of ratings is more useful than buying the most expensive-looking outfit. Colors and makeup don't improve those ratings.

Special Training gives experience through conversations and dates. Better answers or minigame results mean better lessons. Keep doing it alongside the business instead of leaving everything until after Moon.

The date requirements for perfect results are:

- Yuki: at least 90 on both karaoke songs; three stars at disco.
- Ai: three-star disco; beat her at Nine-Ball.
- Saki: three-star disco; beat her at Nine-Ball.
- Hibiki: beat her at Count-Up darts; at least 90 on both karaoke songs.
- Chika: beat her at Nine-Ball; at least 90 on both karaoke songs.
- Mana: beat her at Count-Up darts; three-star disco.

These are perfect-lesson targets, not a claim that every imperfect lesson ruins the run. For the exact conversation choices, keep the individual training answer sheet open rather than guessing through every round.

All six training answer sheets and makeover examples: https://t.co/6yTeFF92pJ

Training order and answer cues

Each hostess has five conversations and two dates. C1–C4 are the four ordinary conversations; Final is the last conversation. Answer cues below describe the correct choice rather than quoting the script. Read each row left to right for its four questions. The date targets are listed above.

Yuki
Order: C1 → C2 → C3 → C4 → karaoke → disco → Final.
- C1: bonsai guess; compliment customers; elderly customers; remind her Majima is male.
- C2: understanding; variety matters; she'd manage; surnames rather than given names.
- C3: engawa preference; enthusiastic acceptance; imagine customers as Majima; acknowledge her effort.
- C4: bonsai; employers misunderstood; promise demanding training; sufficient sleep.
- Final: acknowledge progress; offer support; romantic love; ask him to care for her.

Ai
Order: C1 → C2 → disco → C3 → C4 → pool → Final.
- C1: accompany her; suggest massage; appreciate her arrival; disregard criticism.
- C2: older admirers; professional obligation; authenticity; find it adorable.
- C3: someone resembling her; praise cooking; before Majima's birth; intervene.
- C4: praise progress; feeling better; wealth isn't everything; accept the possibility.
- Final: welcome her; refuse to allow it; overwhelming choices; accompany her.

Japanese training sequence and choices: https://t.co/2GHLkptqTx

Saki
Order: C1 → C2 → disco → C3 → pool → C4 → Final.
- C1: approve her interests; enthusiasm for fried chicken; maternal potential; squash the insect.
- C2: ask about Majima's masculinity; let customers indulge her; pleased customer; he probably wouldn't object.
- C3: determination; daily work; fried chicken; affirmative answer.
- C4: recall brothers; request updates; express missing her; planning matters.
- Final: feminine side; opportunity to study; injury concern; older-brother response.

Hibiki
Order: C1 → C2 → darts → C3 → karaoke → C4 → Final.
- C1: firm affection; avoid overexertion; ask manga genre; reassurance.
- C2: approve arrangement; compliment voice; ask her to pamper Majima; adorable reaction.
- C3: children dislike Majima; discuss women; older women; reassure about them.
- C4: express concern; he'll understand; already occupied; willingness to try.
- Final: excessive workload; fortunate position; generous-hearted man; express gratitude.

Training answers cross-check: https://t.co/bug3FiSi1Y

Chika
Order: C1 → C2 → C3 → pool → C4 → karaoke → Final.
- C1: suitability; contrasting personalities attract; appreciate detours; encourage smiling.
- C2: ask whether deceived; confusion; don't alter herself for him; recognize her talent.
- C3: elegance; shopping especially; disbelief; affirm her importance.
- C4: accept herself; acknowledge passion; ask about family; question whether bad.
- Final: Majima enjoys it; enjoyment belongs to the job; affirm his importance to her; urge her to stay.

Mana
Order: C1 → C2 → C3 → darts → C4 → disco → Final.
- C1: self-reward; characteristic behavior; recognizing similar traits; buy tissues.
- C2: she was truthful; nothing wrong; pursue elderly customers; agreement.
- C3: already has someone; masochism; crashing; seek medical help.
- C4: remove pressure; praise bravery; self-improvement; seriousness.
- Final: she improves the team; psychological explanation; mild jealousy; everyone's value.

English training reference: https://t.co/K1hQWGTCl4. Use these answer meanings, not button sequences: controller layouts differ, and the reference has a reported issue with Mana's third conversation inputs. The written choices above agree with the GameFAQs answer sheet: https://t.co/6yTeFF92pJ.

Buy a head start in each area

Partnerships give fans in the relevant area. Walk up to eligible storefronts and use the Look prompt. These aren't Kiryu's upgradeable real-estate properties.

Here are the full partner checklists. Prices below use millions of yen; “friendship” means finish that character's friendship instead of paying a property fee. The short directions are storefront landmarks, not routes measured from Sunshine.

Mars
- Konno's Meats: 0.5m; SW of Gandhara.
- Rakuen-en: 1.1m; Hogushi Kaikan corner.
- Izakaya Naniwa: 1.5m; Shofukucho West/Hoganji junction.
- Sushi Eeyaro: 1.7m; southeast save point, east.
- Salon Salary Man: 2m; Shofukucho West, black car.
- Salon Rose: 2.5m; S of Mars.
- Nukiya Massage: 3m; W of Sunshine.
- Iiko Massage: 3.6m; stairs beside Mars.
- Cabaret Ron Ron: 4.3m; S of Izakaya Naniwa.
- Gandhara: clerk friendship.

Mars partner prices: https://t.co/6tej1y8HGg

Jupiter
- Smart Ball: 8m; Bunzaemon south save-point, east.
- Bunza Theater: 16m; Bunzaemon corner.
- Maido Diner: 2.5m; N of shogi player.
- Kawachi-ken: 2.8m; southern Bunzaemon, red awning.
- Hyotan: 4.5m; W of warehouse.
- Misuta Realty: 10m; eastern Ashitaba Park.
- Mikado: 2.5m; northern Ashitaba Park.
- Nishihori Rice: 4m; N of Hyotan.
- Sushi Toki: 8m; Hoganji east exit, northeast.
- Yakitori Kabachi: 3.5m; N of Nishihori Rice.

Jupiter partner prices: https://t.co/aiXfFIQCPz

Mercury
- Komian: chef friendship.
- Kokusai Ghetto: 33m; SE of Shofukucho M Store.
- Barber Ashitaba: 3m; S of Majima's apartment.
- Sushi Tsuru: 8m; E of Komian.
- M Zoku Sotenbori: 17.5m; W of Ebisu Pawn.
- Katsu Kin: 8m; S of casino.
- The Megalopolis: 13m; N of Maharaja, blue sign.
- Exodus: 9.5m; N of Maharaja, green awning.
- Hammurabi: 3m; W of Le Marche.
- Ryoshimaru: 5m; S of Le Marche.

Mercury partner prices: https://t.co/GvNHowiDCc

Venus
- SEGA HT LAND: Kyoko friendship.
- Fuguta: 14m; E of Sotenbori M Store.
- Gyu-masu: 22m; E of Dragon & Tiger.
- Sokyu Cinema: 26m; SEGA/Dragon & Tiger gap.
- Cakes Marianne: 15m; W of Kani Douraku.
- Winde West: 55m; W of SEGA.
- Yakitori Torikko: 5m; W of Magutako.
- Death Curry: 11m; E of Tsuruhashi Fugetsu.
- Kabuki Theater: 42m; Fugetsu/M Store gap.
- Crepe Cats: 10m; E of Magutako.

Venus partner prices: https://t.co/ZbK8rgO3qE

Moon
- Shot Bar STIJL: bartender friendship.
- Fuguno Sakai: 87m; W of Kushikatsu Daruma.
- Yokohori Theater: 185m; opposite Zuboraya, slightly west.
- Meshibugyo: 67m; E of Zuboraya.
- Tetsuji's Tripe: 100m; W of Moon.
- Ka-en Restaurant: 56m; opposite Grand, red lanterns.
- Hama-don: 20m; opposite Grand, green mat.
- New Garcia: 25m; Kinryu Ramen, northern corner.
- Namidazaka Bar: 84m; Kinryu/Daikoku gap.
- Akantare: 76m; E of Daikoku Drugstore.

Moon partner list: https://t.co/bXC06ES8e5. New Garcia's 25m fee follows the mapped GameFAQs listing: https://t.co/h8pNfkfkb0 and Steam checklist: https://t.co/0LL3g8GMzg; the wiki lists a conflicting 20m. The GameFAQs maps also show every storefront above if a short landmark isn't enough.

Start with affordable partners and reinvest as the club grows. These are fan investments, so choose the district you're actually trying to advance. Buying somewhere else doesn't solve an empty room in the area you're currently challenging.

Rival battle preparation

The challenge thresholds are Mars 1,500 fans, Jupiter 3,000, Mercury 4,000, Venus 5,000 and Moon 10,000. Those unlock a challenge; they aren't a guarantee your roster is ready.

Mars is balanced. Jupiter favors Party and Sexy, Mercury favors Skill, and Venus favors Talk and Love. Moon brings demanding wealthy customers, so keep broad coverage. Don't make the entire team one specialty just because that area favors it.

Before a challenge, run a recovery shift with backups so your strongest team rests. If you lose, build more fans, improve the roster and retry. Losing isn't a permanent lockout.

My suggested approach is to separate progression shifts from battle attempts. During progression, recruit, train and grow the area. When you decide to challenge the rival, bring your best rested team instead of treating it like another training shift. If the room stays empty, work on fans. If guests arrive but stay unhappy, work on matches and stats. If everything falls apart late, pay closer attention to HP and Fever.

Area preferences, thresholds and preparation reference: https://t.co/0LL3g8GMzg

What changes in each fight

Mars steals customers. Use available Fever rather than waiting endlessly for six occupied tables. Winning gets Ai and ¥300 million, and opens Jupiter, Mercury and Venus.

Jupiter drains HP. Keep Fever available to recover. Saki and ¥1 billion are the rewards.

Mercury damages hostess performance. Be ready to recover instead of relying on the opening matchups all night. Hibiki and ¥1 billion are the rewards.

Venus combines customer theft with HP damage. Yuki becomes unavailable during its story event, so prepare another strong lineup before pushing into that challenge. Winning gets Chika and ¥1 billion.

Moon steals customers and damages performance. Train and rest your strongest roster before taking it on. If its challenge won't trigger while your main-story objective is at the Grand, advance that objective first. Winning gets Mana and ¥10 billion.

These victories also remove combat-upgrade locks. After Moon, continue the business story through the showdown at the Grand. That final stretch unlocks Majima's Mad Dog of Shimano style. Beating the club's sales total isn't the last thing to do.

Rival events and rewards reference: https://t.co/i8wliU0rVT

Before calling this finished

You can conduct one Special Training session with one Platinum per business shift. Work through each hostess's sequence to reach her associated substory. That is why alternating training with ordinary business is useful. Training progression reference: https://t.co/2GHLkptqTx

Keep a short checklist: five rival wins, the final business confrontation, all six Platinums recruited, their training completed, and their associated substories finished. Mana arrives last, so leave time for her rather than assuming Moon clears every remaining requirement.

For full Business completion, also check these counters rather than stopping after the storyline:

- ¥1 billion in total club proceeds.
- 500 customers served.
- 30 accessories purchased for EACH Platinum: Yuki, Ai, Saki, Hibiki, Chika and Mana. Use Makeover → Accessories. This is six separate collections, not thirty shared purchases.
- Recruitment targets: six Bronze, four Silver, four Gold and six Platinum hostesses. CP-temple recruits help your working roster but do NOT count toward these recruitment objectives.
- Ten partner shops in EACH of the five areas, including the friendship partners.
- All five areas taken over, with their fan targets reached: Mars 1,500; Jupiter 3,000; Mercury 4,000; Venus 5,000; Moon 10,000.
- All six Platinum hostess substories completed.

If a small milestone disappears and another appears, keep going. These are the final counter targets, not just the first tier shown in the menu. Business completion requirements: https://t.co/H1rZZuDtTz

The useful routine is simple: train, check condition, choose an area, run the shift, then review what actually held you back. Don't keep repeating a losing setup and expect another attempt to fix it by itself.

Special Training and associated substories: https://t.co/n7u2kHchDn
